description:
Three bundled increments on the now-merged cost-flow feature (lib/costflow.js, lib/human-input.js, GET /costflow, merge-stamp persistence — commit 3709287 on main of /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator):

1. TOP BAR (user decision): display the autonomy score VALUE directly in the dashboard summary/top bar (public/graph.html) — e.g. "⚖ 220×" plus productive-share %, always visible, refreshed from /costflow; the existing popup stays as the click-through detail. Currently only a "⚖ cost" button shows; the number must be visible without clicking.

2. CATCH-ALL SESSION NODES (design note note-mq89ptfjx0y): per-session catch-all node owning main-session tokens not attributed to any task (own = session total minus claim-window task splits), with context edges to every task/note the session created. Sessions producing nothing trap their tokens as named waste. Escalation-gate hook when a catch-all exceeds ~1M tokens with zero outgoing edges. Conservation must still hold — extend test/costflow.test.js.

One-shot script, idempotent, conservative on ambiguous matches (skip, don't guess). This may absorb the existing ready follow-up task filed by the previous build agent — link rather than duplicate.
